business_summary.text: Ratnamani Metals & Tubes is one of India's largest manufacturers of stainless steel and carbon steel pipes and tubes, with four manufacturing facilities in Gujarat and Odisha and subsidiaries in forging, spooling and international trading.

call_points.text: No quantitative revenue or margin guidance was given; management only expressed confidence in long-term growth prospects.
Standalone order book increased to over ₹2,000 Cr.
RFSS holds an active order book exceeding ₹300 Cr (~US$32 million), targeted for execution over the next nine months.
RFSS capacity expansion from 1,400 MT to 4,000 MT annually will be ready by Q3, with commercial production from Q4.
RTL's high-speed hot forming facility is projected for December 2026.
Standalone profitability was hit by lower sales volumes and under-absorption of fixed costs.
The company remains debt free on a standalone basis.
Lower government spending on infrastructure, including water, and Middle East geopolitics affected demand, execution and raw material supplies.
Exports witnessed encouraging growth, and enquiry levels across key markets continue to improve.
Standalone EBITDA margin seen at 16% plus/minus 1%, unless the conflict runs beyond 3-5 months.
Water segment exposure in order book is ₹300-400 Cr; CGD demand mostly ERW pipes.
Routine standalone capex of ₹150-200 Cr; the only major project is the Saudi plant.
Saudi plant design and engineering complete and submitted for approval; trials still targeted within March 2027, with up to three months slippage.
Forex gain for FY26 close to ₹45 Cr on export receivables.
About ₹800 Cr free cash available; company debt-free on standalone basis apart from minor FD-OD utilisation.
Board recommended a lower dividend of ₹10 per share (500% on face value) to conserve resources.
Middle East shipping constraints: only a few ports handling limited cargo, with freight rates customers reject.
Gas cost increase is substantial, hitting carbon steel and some stainless heat-treatment furnaces; management gave no percentage.
Standalone order book stands at over ₹1,800 Crores.
New carbon steel HSAW spiral pipe facility at Kutch scheduled for completion in June 2026.

Ratnamani Metals & Tubes' Q4FY26 earnings call (18 May 2026) guided FY27 standalone revenue at ₹4,800-5,000 Cr on an order book of ₹2,162 Cr as of 1 May, assuming Middle East normalisation within about a month.
